milestone: Native startup, idle behavior, resize profiling, and Nix application packaging
renderer: Native wgpu, automatic backend selection retained; no renderer replacement
changes: Cached editor syntax layout and line numbers
Background source watcher with a bounded notification channel; unchanged source does not redraw the UI
Removed 60 Hz geometry-worker polling; worker completion requests repaint
Removed initial model debounce delay; retained debounce for external edits
Embedded starter source with a personal XDG data copy; no checkout dependency
Added --profile CPU markers and a repeatable Linux X11 profiling harness
Added Nix application package with analyzer, runtime library paths, and desktop entry

installed_profile.method: Three sequential launches; OS caches not flushed. Spawn through observed stderr marker, sampled every 10 ms. Model marker follows CPU GPU-buffer creation. Resize is X11 windowsize requests during a rebuild. UI CPU excludes renderer, GPU completion and presentation. RSS includes mapped graphics-driver pages; excludes child processes and GPU allocations. Idle CPU is one logical core over two seconds after a 500 ms settling interval. Compare runs only with matching adapters.

development_release_vulkan_profile.method: Three sequential launches; OS caches not flushed. Spawn through observed stderr marker, sampled every 10 ms. Model marker follows CPU GPU-buffer creation. Resize is X11 windowsize requests during a rebuild. UI CPU excludes renderer, GPU completion and presentation. RSS includes mapped graphics-driver pages; excludes child processes and GPU allocations. Idle CPU is one logical core over two seconds after a 500 ms settling interval. Compare runs only with matching adapters.

excluded_comparison.description: Xvfb OpenGL selected llvmpipe software rendering, while Vulkan used the RTX 3070. These results were rejected as evidence for a hardware backend switch.

limits: Three local launches are observations, not a statistically controlled benchmark
X11 resize requests verify UI updates during rebuilds; native compositor drag and presentation still need real-desktop testing
CPU markers exclude GPU completion and input-to-photon latency
RSS includes graphics-driver mappings and excludes analyzer child peaks and GPU allocations
Startup and model readiness remain above the stated targets; process memory is not yet minimal
OpenCascade exporter/reference code and external analyzer remain distribution dependencies
next: Profile hardware graphics initialization on the real desktop
Separate OpenCascade reference/export tooling from the everyday CAD binary
Embed analysis or bundle it in a portable release
Measure allocation breakdown and larger models on identical physical adapters
Produce and verify non-Nix distribution artifacts on clean supported systems
